ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-dominance low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution across approx 90% of visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at distal tips and small scattered points; estimated macro ratio of 1:12 white-to-black.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across proximal and medial fluke regions; discrete high-intensity white circular blobs and irregular mottling mapped to the distal 15% of the right lobe (image-right) and the absolute distal tip of the left lobe (image-left).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep bounding-box depth; interior angle estimated at approximately 40-45 pixels wide at the aperture relative to vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular sawtooth pattern with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks along the interior trailing edges; distal tips exhibit extreme irregular topography and volume due to external calcified clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes leading from the median notch to the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of high-contrast circular white rings and clusters concentrated on the upper distal quadrant of the right lobe (image-right).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light-on-dark) visible on the medial-right lobe surface, appearing as shallow diagonal marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, irregular calcified clusters (barnacle colonization) forming physical protrusions at the terminal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Proninent asymmetrical bulbous growth on the left-most tip (image-left) creating a distinct jagged profile compared to the smoother curvature of the lobe body.
